hypotheses.title: Super Alpha Combination: Foreign Currency Translation Hedging with Cash Flow Valuation and Options Demand
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Multinational companies reporting consistently positive after-tax foreign currency translation adjustments (fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_q) possess superior risk management infrastructure. When combined with fundamental cash-flow yield (ebitda / close) or long-dated institutional options volatility demand (implied_volatility_call_1080 / parkinson_volatility_180), the orthogonal signals create a Super Alpha with low mutual correlation, pushing portfolio Sharpe past 2.10 and lifting Fitness into the EXCELLENT tier. Alternatively, isolating liquid multinational equities in TOP1000 removes small-cap accounting noise and elevates signal purity.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if combined fundamental or options factors cancel each other out or increase turnover beyond 25%.
